build_faiss_indexer: build a FAISS indexer using indexer_factory with compressed or exact indexer type options
search_dense_index: search a DenseHNSWFlatIndexer with query vectors to retrieve top matching document ids and vectors
train_compressed_index: train a CompressedIndexer IVF-PQ index on a list of torch tensor embeddings
serialize_index: serialize a BaseIndexer FAISS index and metadata to disk for later deserialization
deserialize_index: deserialize a FAISS index from disk files and restore index id to database id mapping
